features.description: InteractionRouter core protocol: TypeScript types (SystemOutput, InteractionEvent, InteractionMode interface, ModeCapabilities), InteractionRouter class with mode registry, outbound bus, inbound bus, gesture dispatch, and mode lifecycle (enable/disable). Compatibility group enforcement for mutually-exclusive modes.

Vue overlay micro-app: add #overlay-dom div to index.html, mount a Vue app instance on the overlay for DOM-overlay modes (Bark, SpeechBubble, RadialMenu, EmoteWheel, BondIndicator). Provides overlayContainer in ModeContext. Must not interfere with existing Canvas 2D RAF loop.

Gesture dispatch refactor: replace hardcoded dblclick→openPetManager('/chat') and contextmenu→openPetManager('/care') in main.ts with InteractionRouter.handleGesture() calls. Wire InteractionRouter into overlay bootstrap. Setup-events.ts routes agent/care events through router's handleOutput().

BarkMode: implements InteractionMode. Typewriter effect (50ms/char), auto-fade (2.5s hold + 0.5s fade), queue max 3 barks. Positions above pet. Responds to agent_text and care_need_critical SystemOutput types. DOM overlay rendering.

ThoughtBubbleMode: implements InteractionMode. Icon rendering (emoji mapping per need), bounce animation, critical pulse (red border), icon rotation when multiple needs active. Responds to care_need_critical and care_state SystemOutput types. Canvas or DOM overlay.

SpeechBubbleMode: implements InteractionMode. Comic-style DOM overlay bubble with typewriter, quick-reply chips, position-flip below pet when near top of screen. Responds to agent_text with streaming support. Dispatches chat_message InteractionEvent on chip click.

RadialMenuMode: implements InteractionMode. SVG ring with 4 segments (Feed/Play/Sleep/Chat), angle calculation via atan2, segment highlight on mouse-over, care action dispatch on release. Opens on context_menu gesture. Dims pet canvas during display.

EmoteWheelMode: implements InteractionMode. Radial-derived wheel with Wave/Cheer/Scold/Dance slots, emote-to-FSM-state mapping, emote-to-bark mapping, care effect dispatch. Opens on emote_key gesture (E key). Selecting emote triggers pet animation + bark + care effect.

TouchZoneMode: implements InteractionMode. Zone rectangles from skin.json (head/body/belly/limbs/tail), hitTest delegation to PetRenderer or fallback to skin.json rects, hover detection (>500ms shows zone highlight), click dispatches touch InteractionEvent with zone name. Different bark reactions per zone.

DialogPanelMode: integrates existing Pet Manager /chat route with InteractionRouter. When DialogPanel is the primary chat mode in the profile, handleGesture('double_click') opens Pet Manager at /chat instead of hardcoding. No new WebviewWindow; reuses existing Pet Manager.

BondLevel engine (Rust backend): new care/bond.rs module. Bond points accumulation with threshold table (10 levels, 0/50/150/300/500/800/1200/1800/2500/3500), daily caps per action type, SQLite persistence via new bond_level table migration, Tauri event emission on level-up. IPC commands: get_bond_state, award_bond_points.

BondIndicator + level-up ceremony: Vue overlay component showing Lv.N + heart-bar near pet, always visible when bond_level mode enabled. Level-up ceremony: full-screen overlay animation (sparkles + BOND UP text) + unlock notification listing newly available modes. Responds to bond_level_up SystemOutput.

Bond → FSM animation gating + system prompt tier modifier. FSM gains min_bond_level annotation per state variant; skin manifests can declare animation variants (e.g., idle.standard, idle.cuddle at Lv.5+). agent/prompt.rs appends bond tier guide string to system prompt (Lv.1-2: formal, Lv.3-4: casual, Lv.5-6: warm, Lv.7-8: trusting, Lv.9-10: authentic).

Interaction profiles + Settings UI extension: Minimal/Nurture/RPG profile presets with per-mode enabled flags and gesture maps. Profile switching correctly mounts/unmounts modes and updates gesture mapping. Mode compatibility enforcement (Group A: speech_bubble|dialog_panel|command_input|chat_log mutually exclusive; Group B: radial_menu|emote_wheel mutually exclusive). Settings UI with profile selector + mode toggle list + bond-gated mode visibility. IPC commands: get_interaction_config, save_interaction_config.
